items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I ran into Willard Robinson Rose and he asked me if I would do some things for him and his Deep River orchestra.

ctx.x: All right, so what did you do after that and let's synopsize this.

Well, I got out of the Whiteman band and I called up Nat or Nat called me up, heard about it and he wanted to know if I'd do some work in the radio and I had been in touch -- I ran into Willard Robinson Rose and he asked me if I would do some things for him and his Deep River orchestra. Bill had still been working with us in the Whiteman band on the radio show, so I don't know what he did, I think he went out to the coast, or he did something else.

Anyway, Willard asked me to do some work for him and I did, so I was sort of free-lancing around, at different places. I did a couple of things, and I also did some work for Don Vorhees and none of this jelled for me because it didn't jell for any of these guys except Nat.
